title: RSR-005 (control 17): a research record's evidence_digest is computed, not asserted
objective: Enforce control 17: evidence_digest = sha256 of the record's material evidence (sources, claims, contradictions, experiments), computed by the gate; a stale or null digest is refused. This is the last record-pure control (15 of 18).
business_value: An unchecked evidence_digest is decorative; computing it makes 'the record changed when the evidence changed' true, so a downstream decision can trust the record it cites.
out_of_scope: controls 3 (baseline git-resolution -- repository-research subskill) and 6 (source-digest staleness) -- need machinery beyond a record check; separate later work with operator scoping
the nine P0 subskills; registry activation (badf-research stays DESIGNED)
acceptance_criteria: both examples carry the computed digest and pass
a claim or source edited without re-digesting is refused; editing interpretation is not
re-digesting after a real edit passes
mutation kills; compose green both shapes

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design. Own G07 self-dossier. The last record-pure control (15/18); 3 and 6 remain, needing a subskill and a source-fetch, to be scoped with the operator. badf-research stays DESIGNED.
